## Why it matters

The Perry-Castañeda Library Map Collection is a long-running online collection of scanned maps hosted by the University of Texas Libraries.

It remains useful as a straightforward source for locating map images quickly, especially for teaching, reference checks, and preliminary cartographic comparison.
